violated_contract: A dispatch retry deadline is not evidence that an execution owner expired. Advancing the execution epoch before delivery invalidates queued tasks; when queue delay exceeds the retry interval, every delivery is stale and the durable queue livelocks.
canonical_prevention: Keep the execution epoch stable while dispatching and use a separate persisted dispatch attempt for idempotent replacement task names. Advance the execution epoch only when recovering expired running work. Exercise delayed original and replacement deliveries after repeated redrives, including flag-off draining, and retain the expired-running fence regression.
